reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Validation Rules with Assertion Trees: Kyverno-JSON allows Kyverno policies to be used anywhere, even for non-Kubernetes workloads", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: No operational consequence: operators only gain a new opt-in option — writing validation rules with assertion trees; the evidence describes no failure, rejection, ignored setting, or change to existing policies or workloads.

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds the ability to use assertion trees (previously CLI-only, from Kyverno-JSON) as a sub-type of validation rules, so Kyverno policies can also validate non-Kubernetes workloads; the evidence names no schema field for this capability and describes no impact on existing behavior.
